newsitem.title: CHINA: Domestically made computers dominate China market.
newsitem.headline: Domestically made computers dominate China market.

text.p: The share of domestically made computers in China soared to 56 percent in 1996 from 35 percent in 1995, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.
More than 1.0 million of 1.8 million computers sold in China this year were made domestically, Xinhua said.
Legend Group, China's biggest computer firm, sold 250,000 computers in 1996, or 1.5 times more than its sales in 1995, it said.
Xinhua attributed the rise in market share to price cuts by the domestic computer producers.
Legend slashed its prices four times in 1996, it said.
